description: Registry of the document schema ids known to the OBC v3 standard. A schema version, once published, never changes; new fields mean obc.<type>/<n+1>. Issue references are in the SHAliakbari/OBC repository: #47 is the v3 specification, #48 is support for more document types.

schemas.description: Journal content: the v2 off-chain journal document without its top-level version.
Reserved for invoices. Drafted in SHAliakbari/OBC#48 (support for more document types).
